thread:
Sam: Heads up team — our HubSpot unassigned lead count just spiked, claim SLA breaches climbing. Anyone tracking root cause?
Nia: Yep, enrichment service spiking. HS->enrich webhook latency jumping to 20-30s, then retries cause the lead to sit in limbo. We get back a 502 sometimes.
Carlos: Could we try a lightweight optimistic flow: set `provisional_owner` immediately on receipt, surface to SDRs, then replace with final owner after enrichment finishes? That should reduce visible unassigned backlog.
Priya: Caution: Salesforce connector expects owner provenance. If provisional_owner gets overwritten later we need a reconciliation record to avoid churn and duplicate notifications.
Sam: Good point. Proposal: provisional_owner set instantly, mark lead with `owner_state=provisional` + `provisional_ttl=600s`. If enrichment completes within TTL, finalize owner and clear flag. If TTL expires, trigger reconcile job to re-enter RR.
Nia: I like that. Also add a `provisional_reason=enrichment_latency` tag so reporting can filter.
Carlos: Implementation sketch (HubSpot workflow + small lambda):
```yaml
workflow: inbound-provisional-assign
conditions:
  - enrichment_status: unknown
actions:
  - set_property: provisional_owner = next_on_round_robin()
  - set_property: owner_state = provisional
  - set_property: provisional_ttl = 600
  - emit_event: provisional_assigned
```
Lambda would listen to `enrichment.complete` and `provisional_ttl.expired` events.
Priya: Add two safeguards: 1) if `owner` already exists do not overwrite, 2) on finalize, push a single audit note so SF/HUB logs show seamless change.
Nia: I'll instrument telemetry: tag events with `flow=provisional` and `experiment=optimize-2026-03`. We'll track claim latency, finalization rate, and owner-flip count.
Sam: Can we gate behind a feature flag and roll to 5% of inbound traffic first? Want to ensure no negative impact on SDR workflows.
Carlos: Yep. I'll add feature flag and a dashboard. Also adding a backstop: if provisional_assign_rate > 40% or owner-flip_rate > 2% in 15m, auto-disable.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `leadflow/provisional-assign` (5% traffic).
Priya: I'll draft a short runbook for SDRs and ops: how to identify provisional owners, how to handle flagged duplicates, and how to escalate to eng-sre. Saving to Confluence: https://docs.redwood.com/confluence/leadflow/provisional-runbook (internal).
Sam: Action list: Nia = telemetry + canary checks, Carlos = feature flag + auto-disable, Priya = runbook + SF sync audit, I'll monitor SLA dashboards and ping if anything drifts. Check-in in 90m. :watch:
Nia: On it. Will post first 15m metrics here.
Carlos: Also adding a reconciliation job to run every 10m to catch TTL expiries and re-enqueue to RR.
Sam: Thanks all. If we see big regressions we revert flag and run the TTL-only rollback plan. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary health checks ok for 10m; traffic at 5%. No error increase observed.
